name: colorcombinations
description: The Dictionary of Color Combinations — historically-grounded color palettes inspired by Sanzo Wada's 1933 Japanese color dictionary.

scripts._deploy_note: (rewritten 2026-10-15; the old note said CI was canonical and out of minutes until 2026-10-01, both superseded) PRODUCTION DEPLOYS ARE LOCAL: run `bash deploy.sh` (or `npm run deploy`). CI is VALIDATE-ONLY since 2026-09-24 (.gitlab-ci.yml header): its deploy step was removed because rg-freeze-guard and its register exist only on the Macs, so a CI deploy shipped with no freeze check. A push to main therefore does NOT deploy. deploy.sh builds, runs every guard (git freshness + RG freeze, amazon tracking, deploy integrity pre/post, offline /go gate, page-class census on the FRESH dist), then uploads with the chunked deployer because dist is ~174MB across ~3,960 files and CF Pages resets an upload connection at ~56MB. The page-class census used to sit in predeploy, where it ran BEFORE the build: on a clean checkout `npm run deploy` failed (no dist/), and on a dirty one it censused the previous build. It now runs inside deploy.sh after `npm run build`. OG/pin PNGs are cached in node_modules/.cache/og-png (src/lib/og-png.ts), so a warm build is ~8 min instead of ~70.
